text:
mira: kicking off the phased rollout for v3.2.1 across regions. starting US canary now. deploybot told me us-slice=10% -> canary. :rocket:
deploy-bot: started rollout slice=us percent=10 model=redwood-v3.2.1 image=sha256:abcd1234 tag=stable deploy_id=deploy-4923456789

dan: quick capacity check for US GPUs? what pools are backing this canary?
jess: us canary should live on pool-g4dn-small (warm) + pool-t4-burst as fallback. target qps for canary = 200 qps.
nina-sre: looked at pool metrics 10m ago — free_slots=18 on pool-g4dn-small, t4 fallback free_slots=6. thermal headroom ok for next 30m. p95 serving latency baseline ~120ms.
sam-platform: note — the canary routing policy will overflow to eu if us fails, double-check pinning rules if we want strict regional pin.
mira: good call. pin v3.2.1 to US only for this slice. we want EU/APAC untouched until green. jess please add pin in deploy config.
jess: done. pin config snippet:
```
regions:
  us:
    pin: redwood-v3.2.1
  eu: 
    pin: redwood-v3.2.0
  apac:
    pin: redwood-v3.2.0
```

mira: rollback criteria (proposal):
- error_rate >= 1.5% sustained for 5m
- p95 latency increase > 200ms relative to baseline for 5m
- consumer-facing 5xx spike > 3x baseline for 3m
- explicit customer impact alert from CS or monitoring

ops-oncall: add health-check for model mismatch too — some clients depend on output schema. if structure delta > 2 fields -> auto hold.

deploy-bot: canary progress: 10% -> 25% after 12m if no blockers. next auto-step scheduled at +15m.
dan: can someone run a quick smoke against reranking route? I saw slight score drift in staging yesterday.
nina-sre: running smoke now. snippet: `curl -X POST https://staging-api.internal/score -d '{"q":"hello"}'`

nina-sre: smoke results: 200 OK, mean latency 135ms, sample outputs look ok. no schema diffs.
mira: if next 15m looks green, we move to 50% in US then hold 20m for telemetry. no EU/APAC traffic until explicit thumbs up.
sam-platform: accounting note — if we hold at 50% more than 1h, we trigger warm-pool scale to +2 for eu/pre-warm should we need immediate fallback. ops-oncall can coordinate.
ops-oncall: noted. I'll watch the thermal dashboards and scale hooks. set me a pager if p95 > 400ms.

jess: rolling changelog entry drafted and posted to #releases: "v3.2.1: latency fixes + sampling seed stability". link: https://go/releases/3.2.1

mira: thumbs. :thumbsup: anyone object to proceeding?
dan: no objections. go for 25% in 5m.
deploy-bot: progressing to 25% now — will report back at 4923456845.

mira: (note) if we see any regional spillover, manually flip pin on eu/apac to v3.2.0 first, then investigate.

deploy-bot: rollout step complete: 25% -> success.
nina-sre: live metrics look clean. p95 130ms, errors 0.3%. no anomalies in logs.
mira: ok holding for telemetry window. ops-oncall if anything noisy ping here asap.

(16 minutes later)
ops-oncall: noticed transient queue growth in t4 fallback at +8m, but autoscaler caught up. no user impact.
mira: thanks. continuing hold. next candidate is 50% at +20m checkpoint.

(Last)
ops-oncall: final check green. recommend EU canary tomorrow morning at 02:00 UTC with same process.
mira: agreed. schedule EU for 02:00 UTC, APAC next day 10:00 UTC. closing thread once EU canary starts. :white_check_mark:
